meaning_ko: 가벼운 일이 아닌 것, 결코 만만치 않은 일
example_en: Raising three children alone is no light matter.

meaning_ko: 아무런 조건 없이, 대가를 바라지 않고
example_en: He offered me the money with no strings attached.
The committee spent hours in nonproductive argument.

word: not so much a as b
example_en: She is not so much a singer as an actress.

meaning_ko: 객체 탐지(영상 속 사물의 종류와 위치를 찾아내는 기술)
example_en: Self-driving cars rely on object detection to spot pedestrians.
It never occurred to me that she might refuse.
The village is small enough to explore on foot.
The plan is cheap; on the other hand, it takes far longer.
The course is oriented to beginners with no coding background.
His anger was completely out of proportion to the mistake.
The map on the wall is badly out-of-date.
One unusually tall student was an outlier in the data.
Deer became overabundant once wolves disappeared.
Her overemphasized gestures made the scene look unnatural.
Overpopulation puts heavy pressure on water supplies.

meaning_ko: (육종의) 부모 계통, 교배종의 바탕이 되는 원종
example_en: Breeders cross two parent lines to create a hybrid variety.
A neighbor waved at us while passing by the gate.

meaning_ko: 퍼센트 포인트(두 백분율 사이의 차이를 나타내는 단위)
example_en: Support for the plan rose by five percentage points.
Remote work has made many jobs far less place-bound.
The singer listened to the playback of her first take.
His documentaries helped the popularization of astronomy.
The city took pre-emptive steps before the storm arrived.
Newly hatched turtles follow a preprogrammed route to the sea.

meaning_ko: 현재 편향적인(먼 미래의 이익보다 당장의 만족을 앞세우는)
example_en: Present-biased shoppers spend now and regret it later.
Cheap electricity was the prime mover behind the boom.
Small pro-environmental habits add up over a year.
A product-oriented class judges only the final essay.
She was proud of her younger brother.

meaning_ko: (전체 맥락 속에서) 균형 있게 바라보다, 대수롭지 않게 여기게 되다
example_en: A week in the hospital put my small worries in perspective.

meaning_ko: 합리적 행위자(비용과 이익을 따져 선택한다고 가정되는 개인)
example_en: Economic models often treat each buyer as a rational actor.
Wildflowers quickly recolonize burned hillsides.
His first salary became the reference point for every later offer.
Please fill out the registration form before Friday.
The report lists three remediations for the leaking roof.
The bare slope recovered after reseeding with native grasses.
Many oaks survive fire by resprouting from the roots.
Rest assured, your luggage will arrive tomorrow.
Cedar is rot-resistant, so it suits outdoor decks.

meaning_ko: 기계적으로 암기한, 뜻은 모른 채 통째로 외운
example_en: Rote-learned formulas fade once the exam is over.
The doctor began by ruling out a broken bone.
She decided to run for class president.
They played baseball on a dusty sandlot after school.
He apologized quietly so his rival could save face.

meaning_ko: (단점을 덮어 주는) 유일한 장점, 그나마 다행인 점
example_en: The hotel was noisy, but the view was its saving grace.
Korea recorded the second highest score in the survey.
Soaking softens the hard seed coat so the plant can sprout.

meaning_ko: (다음 해에 심으려고) 씨앗을 받아 두기, 채종
example_en: Seed saving lets farmers plant next spring without buying grain.

meaning_ko: 그 자체로 완결된, 독립적인, 외부 도움이 필요 없는
example_en: Each chapter is self-contained and can be read alone.

meaning_ko: 자기 완결성, 외부와 교류 없이 스스로 갇혀 있음
example_en: The club’s self-containment kept out fresh ideas.

meaning_ko: 자기 고양(자신을 실제보다 좋게 평가하려는 경향)
example_en: Praising our own honesty is a familiar form of self-enhancement.

meaning_ko: 자기 지침(자신이 되고자 하는 이상적·당위적 자아상)
example_en: A large gap between reality and our self-guides breeds anxiety.

meaning_ko: 자기 감시(남에게 비치는 자기 모습을 스스로 살피고 조절하기)
example_en: People high in self-monitoring change their manner with each audience.
A healthy forest is largely self-regulating.
The program teaches teenagers self-responsibility for their money.
The island aims at food self-sufficiency within ten years.

meaning_ko: 감각 상태(해석되기 전의 날것 그대로의 감각)
example_en: Pain and hunger are sensory states we notice at once.
The novel was first serialized in a weekly magazine.

meaning_ko: 따로 떼어 두다, 챙겨 두다, (감정·의견을) 제쳐 두다
example_en: She sets aside an hour each night for reading.

meaning_ko: 건전한 선을 긋다, 적절한 경계를 정하다
example_en: Learning to set healthy limits protects your free time.
The captain shared out the last of the water.
